name: region
label: Region
help: The PostHog Cloud region your account is hosted in. Choose EU if you sign in at eu.posthog.com, otherwise US.

name: personalApiKey
label: Personal API key
help: A PostHog personal API key (starts with `phx_`). Create one at **Settings → Personal API keys**. Grant read scopes for Organization, Project, Feature flag, and Query so all data streams work.
